## Safety impact

- [ ] No scan, plan, cache, or file-mutation behavior changes

## Validation

List the commands and manual checks you ran.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documented where behavior changed.
- [ ] Tests cover the regression or behavior change.
- [ ] Frontend source changes include an updated review-ui/bundle.html.
- [ ] No private video, library path, report, plan, cache, or quarantine artifact is included.
- [ ] git diff --check passes.
